rcsb-1MAB.checked: 2026-10-01: title RAT LIVER F1-ATPASE (file and RCSB data API); Rattus norvegicus; X-ray, 2.8 angstrom; the file holds one alpha (510 residues), one beta (479) and one gamma chain (270 residues in the sequence, of which the file models 124), plus ATP, ADP, one Mg and one phosphate; assembly 1 (author defined, heptameric) applies the crystal symmetry to give three alpha, three beta and one gamma.
